reviews.review:
My belief of the best game there is 

I started on Xbox, and then switched to PC. Both are great experiences. This game's new player experience can be somewhat a grind from when I started, however I come to understand that it is much better. Warframe is not a complex game, it is merely simple systems (frames, mods, companions, starchart, rivens, etc) layered onto one another that make this game seem complex. With some basic effort, I believe many people can grow into this style of game. 

Every single piece of content in this game is 100% free. In fact, everything is so free and great, you feel bad not wanting to give them some money for cosmetic items. 

The community is absolutely amazing, join a guild and you'll meet some great people. The game is truly founded on the best fanbase I've seen in gaming. 

This game is a grind in the end. The content is always being updated (regular large expansions every few months, with active hotfixes and bug fixes occuring frequently) 

I would truly recommend this game to anybody. I always come back to it and enjoy the newly added frames and maps and storyline. This game truly has it all. Great visuals, fun mechanics, limitless combinations of weapons, and nearly every kind of playstyle for your favorite sort of farming or looting. It takes a very long time to get to the true end state of this game, and even then, the developers still add new content to explore and play with. 

Great game. DE did amazing with this one! Still active fanbase too despite it's age.

As someone who was utterly in love with Destiny (before it went down the toilet), this game for sure gives off the same vibes that I have missed over the years, while also adding new flares and excitement that I did not know that I was missing out on. Very fun game.
